THE +5 IN http_routing IS THIS CHANGE'S OWN, AND IT IS A TRADE BETWEEN TWO GATES.
`869409d761a`'s comment strip took the nine `# See /N,` markers out of the
language ladder in `models/ir_http.py`. `ARCHITECTURE.md`'s case table is keyed
on them and http_routing's `factcheck.sh` asserts the code still carries them, so
that harness has been 8 failed of 86 since. Restoring the nine marker lines --
the directives, not the explanatory prose the same commit deliberately removed --
takes `_reroute_for_lang` from 76 lines to 85. A nine-branch decision ladder whose
branches map one-to-one onto a documented case table is not a function to split;
5 lines of budget is the right price for nine gated cross-references, and it is
recorded here rather than absorbed.

`addons/web` is -5 of the move and carries 17 offenders / 2219 excess of the
20237 that remain, `web_read` alone 299 of it.
